papers.disposition: Do not implement generic private GRANOLA as a novel mechanism.
papers.operation: Auxiliary GNN on intermediate states plus sampled random node features generates node/channel affine gamma/beta for node-wise LayerNorm; no-RNF alternative is explicit.
papers.scope_limit: Norm/relu loss examples do not establish information loss in residual pre-LN native PolyFormer. RNF universality statements are not audited finite-width task guarantees.
papers.strongest_collision: Graph-conditional normalization and random-feature expressivity are established; Tiny Deep Ensemble separately establishes private normalization capacity. Their composition alone is not novelty.
papers.title: GRANOLA: Adaptive Normalization for Graph Neural Networks

papers.disposition: Save as strongest graph-centering prior; no new fit.
papers.operation: GraphNormv2 learns per-channel spectral centering projections V tau tau^T V^T, retains original GraphNorm/BN via an additional residual ones-vector.
papers.scope_limit: Theory setup uses symmetric nonnegative graph operators and specific feature/residual conditions; not certified for native featurewise LayerNorm, nonlinear attention or current shared errors.
papers.strongest_collision: Learnable structural centering is established; privatizing those projections is an allocation adaptation, not a new normalization principle.
papers.title: Residual Connections and Normalization Can Provably Prevent Oversmoothing in GNNs

papers.bounded_gap: Printed z_ol has no node index; a local structurally conditioned hop uncertainty field is not this exact global posterior. Node-MoE and edge-posterior methods remain direct adjacent priors.
papers.correctness_limit: Printed q uses continuous ConcreteBernoulli while p uses Bernoulli; literal KL between these supports is not finite. Author implementation or a common relaxed underlying model is needed to resolve actual semantics. No author failure is asserted.
papers.disposition: Strongest stochastic shared-backbone comparator and one local-scope research lead.
papers.operation: Global beta stick-breaking hop probabilities; channel-by-layer concrete/Bernoulli masks; shared point-weight GNN with residuals; truncated variational objective; multiple structure samples use the same W.
papers.strongest_collision: Shared-weight stochastic propagation ensembles are already explicit in Eq2-8 and Algorithm1. Node conditioning, posterior draws or calling masks Bayesian alone cannot establish novelty.
papers.title: Bayesian Neighborhood Adaptation for Graph Neural Networks
papers.truncation_limit: Actual variational T is finite; no finite implementation with unlimited neighborhood depth is certified.
